NAME: Isotropic Torsion-Lace
GENESIS: Gluing the interior of a manifold to its own infinitesimal boundary-flow via a non-orientable twist.
FORMAL_SEED: $\partial M \cong \text{Diff}(M) / \text{Isom}(M)$
STRANGE_PROPERTY: Locally Euclidean, but every closed loop accumulates a fractional dimension instead of a phase.
NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: Non-commutative Torus
WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: It possesses a metric that vanishes on the connectivity itself, rather than the coordinates.
COUNTERFEIT: Fiber Bundle
BREAK_IT: Let the twisting frequency exceed the Planck-scale resolution of the manifold's topology.
NEXT_MUTATION: Temporal-Recurrence Quotient
